title: A two-categorical Snake Lemma: Lean 4 formalisation
description:
A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalisation accompanying the paper A two-categorical Snake Lemma, by Elena Caviglia, Luca Mesiti and Tim Van der Linden.

It machine-checks 2-kernels and 2-cokernels, 2-monomorphisms and 2-epimorphisms, normality and dinversion, short 2-exact sequences, the Pure Snake Lemma, and the Snake Lemma itself both in a 2-di-exact 2-category and under the non-self-dual hypotheses, with the classical Snake Lemma recovered as the locally discrete case. It also carries the lattice models and the abelian-category material of the paper's later sections.

The repository ships a leanblueprint view of the paper, published at https://tvdlinde.github.io/snake-lean/, whose dependency graph records which statements are formalised and which are not.

The formalisation is supplementary: no argument of the paper rests on it.
